incidents.summary: Ofgem fined SSE more than £2 million for delayed disclosure that Fiddler's Ferry generating units would remain operational, leaving electricity traders uninformed for four trading days.

incidents.summary: Ofgem named SSE among 18 suppliers that breached tariff-price protection rules when customers switched supplier or tariff, with the suppliers issuing refunds and redress.
